analysis.lean: No game-side edge: BOS is a fair -12 favorite against a 0-3 BKN team, so pass or take a small prop angle instead.
why: The projection of BOS +12.2 and a 222.0 total matches the market's -12.0 and 221.5, and the blend lands at +12.0 and 221.6.
BOS has the better adjusted net rating (+4.9 vs -6.5 per 100) on only 3 games each, and the ratings are shrunk toward average.
BKN allows a 0.607 eFG and 123.7 points per game raw, a weak defense. The matchup expected points per shot favor BOS (1.174 vs BKN 0.999, league 1.084).
Both teams take many threes (BKN 45%, BOS 47%) and both defenses allow 50% of shots from three versus a 42% league rate. That is a variance factor for the total, not a lean.
BOS is on a back-to-back and BKN is on the third game in four nights. The packet counts neither as proven, so neither moves the numbers.
risks: A 12-point spread raises blowout risk, which can cut minutes for Tatum, George and White and for the BKN starters.
Sample sizes are tiny (3 games), so every rating, shot-zone figure and prop average is noisy.
BOS is on a back-to-back and Devin Carter is out with mono, which could affect the rotation.
matchups: BOS defense allows forwards +10% threes and centers +17% threes (small sample), which helps BKN's three-point shooters like Porter and Clowney.
verify: Check the final injury reports for both teams near tip, including any BOS rest decisions on the back-to-back.
Check the referee crew once it is posted.
Compare the spread across books, since 12.0 could move to 11.5 or 12.5.

judgment.why: Our projection (+12.2, 222.0) is almost the same as the market (-12.0, 221.5), and with only 3 games each there is no concrete reason to move off the fair price.
